gates.description: Each issue must reference a WCAG criterion
Each issue must have severity (critical, major, minor)
Report must include keyboard navigation testing results
Each finding must include a remediation recommendation
Report must include manual testing results (not just automated scan)
Color contrast verification must be present

anti_patterns.description: Relying solely on axe-core or Lighthouse — automation catches ~30% of issues
Recommending third-party accessibility overlay widgets as a solution
Adding ARIA to elements that already have native semantics
Treating accessibility as a post-launch audit rather than continuous evaluation

escalation_triggers: Design requires a custom widget with no accessible ARIA Authoring Practices pattern
Legal or compliance risk: accessibility lawsuit or regulatory deadline
Business decision explicitly excludes accessibility implementation
Screen reader testing reveals a fundamental structural architecture flaw
Third-party component is inaccessible with no alternative available

output_certifications: Accessibility audit report exists with WCAG criterion mapping
All critical severity issues documented with remediation steps
Keyboard navigation verified for all interactive elements
Screen reader testing completed on primary user flows
No accessibility issues rated critical without a remediation path
